name: book-reader
description: Opens your PDF book while Claude works, or reads it inside the terminal; resumes where you stopped, remembers read pages, and tells you when the task is done.

autoOpen.title: Open the book automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the current book when a task has been running for the delay below.

openDelaySeconds.title: Delay before opening (seconds)
openDelaySeconds.description: How long a task must run before the book opens; 0 opens it at once.

window.title: Reader window
window.description: app: a window of its own in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium or Vivaldi when one is installed; browser: a tab in your default browser.

mode.title: Reading mode
mode.description: browser: the book opens in its own window; text: it is read inside the Reading Dock as text (pictures on kitty and Ghostty). /book mode changes it any time.

notify.title: Desktop notification when a task finishes
notify.description: Show a desktop notification (besides the dialog in the reader) when the task you were reading through ends. On Linux this needs notify-send.

port.title: Reader server port
port.description: Local port of the reader server (127.0.0.1 only).

nodePath.title: Path to node
nodePath.description: Leave empty to find node on PATH and in the usual install folders (Homebrew, nvm, fnm, Volta, asdf, mise; Program Files on Windows).
